Everything in the iPhone app

Pi — The Game is already beautifully polished on the web. The iPhone version adds all the features that make serious memorization actually feasible.

Write your own piem

Compose a poem where each word's length encodes a digit of pi. The app checks your letter counts as you type.

Voice mode

Have the digits of pi read aloud to you. Perfect for memorizing while walking, cooking or commuting.

Performance statistics

See detailed stats on your accuracy, your hottest streaks and how you're improving over time.

Sound effects

Subtle audio cues reinforce each correct digit. Memory-science-approved, and extremely satisfying.

Reverse button order

Flip the keypad layout to match your thumbs. Small detail, huge ergonomics win for long sessions.

Game Center integration

Full iOS leaderboards and achievements. Compare your progress with pi lovers around the world.

Try it in your browser first

If you're not sure yet, play the free web version — you can beat a 50-digit streak today.
